mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, name, district, address, opening_hours, current_serving_no, last_ticket_no, avg_service_minutes, active FROM bank_branches WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, district, address, opening_hours, current_serving_no, last_ticket_no, avg_service_minutes, active FROM bank_branches WHERE id = #{id} AND active = 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM branch_tickets WHERE branch_id = #{branchId} AND status = 'WAITING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO branch_tickets (branch_id, user_id, summary_id, ticket_no, purpose, status) VALUES (#{branchId}, #{userId}, #{summaryId}, #{ticketNo}, #{purpose}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE branch_tickets SET summary_id = #{summaryId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.branch_id, t.user_id, t.summary_id, t.ticket_no, t.purpose, t.status, t.issued_at, t.called_at, t.cancelled_at, b.name AS branch_name, b.address AS branch_address, b.current_serving_no, b.avg_service_minutes, s.code AS summary_code FROM branch_tickets t JOIN bank_branches b ON b.id = t.branch_id LEFT JOIN counter_summaries s ON s.id = t.summary_id WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT t.id, t.branch_id, t.user_id, t.summary_id, t.ticket_no, t.purpose, t.status, t.issued_at, t.called_at, t.cancelled_at, b.name AS branch_name, b.address AS branch_address, b.current_serving_no, b.avg_service_minutes, s.code AS summary_code FROM branch_tickets t JOIN bank_branches b ON b.id = t.branch_id LEFT JOIN counter_summaries s ON s.id = t.summary_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.status IN ('WAITING', 'CALLED') ORDER BY t.issued_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE branch_tickets SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'WAITING'
